title: Identify three European home archive streams
platforms: European ROM; prior Windows via Wine evidence
changes: Document a source-backed relative directory, original resolver and three custom-compressed streams observed in the recorded home scene; retain extraction and runtime consumption as open work.
validation: Static e208-home-source-rwsqv1y7 authenticates the exact EUR ROM and original resolver/decoder instruction pins, confirms relative directory cells 69, 71 and 73, decodes 6041 sampled source bytes and verifies their hashes and disjointness from E202 owners.
limitations: The preceding E207 Wine capture is address-only and does not identify the instructions executed there. Extraction and runtime consumption, other entries/callers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No guest replay or performance measurement was made for E208.
